meta.title: Chinese Car Parts
meta.description: A brokerage platform connecting you with verified suppliers and manufacturers of Chery, Changan, Jetour, Geely and Haval parts, with an itemized price before you pay.

home.title: Parts for your Chinese car, with a clear itemized price before you pay
home.subtitle: We connect you with verified suppliers and manufacturers. A part is shown as available only if the supplier confirmed it recently.
home.notice: The platform is being set up. Part search and quote requests open once the first suppliers are approved.

s1.title: Search or request
s1.body: Search by name or part number, or request a part that isn't listed.

s2.title: We check with suppliers
s2.body: We ask more than one supplier to confirm availability, price and lead time.

s3.title: Approve the cost
s3.body: You get an itemized cost: part, shipping and fees, each marked confirmed or estimated.

s4.title: Payment and preparation
s4.body: After you approve, the supplier prepares the part.

s5.title: Shipping and tracking
s5.body: Follow your order and shipment until delivery.

principles.p1: We state the part type clearly: genuine, aftermarket, used or refurbished.
principles.p2: We separate the part price from shipping, fees, tax and the platform commission.
principles.p3: We never show a final total while a mandatory fee is still unknown.

home.partnerBody: Partners join by invitation for now, and every company is reviewed and approved before any activity on the platform.
